title: 第21章 大王所图甚大啊第22章 昊天遮天降罪人皇
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第21章大王，所图甚大啊！朝歌，
太师府！
“这一代人皇有些不简单啊，竟然要做真正的洪荒之主！”
金灵圣母看着下方的闻仲，自言自语道。
不久前，在她听到帝辛说‘孤要这洪荒，尽归我大商’之后，就一直处于震惊中。
甚至这句话给她带来的震动，比之之前看到菩提道人时，还要强烈数倍！
而听到金灵圣母的话后，闻仲笑着点了点头——
极度自豪地说道：“大王雄才大略，徒儿被先帝托孤，辅导大王，徒儿感到很是欣慰！”
他还是第一次看到自己的师父，在短短一天的时间内，露出数次震惊的表情。
“嗯，看来之前是我对他产生了偏见！”
金灵圣母一想到自己来朝歌的目的，就感觉到十分的好笑，要不是自己身份在这里，就凭帝辛那句话，说不得也要支持他几年。
就在这时，闻仲再度笑着说道：“对了，不知道师尊这次来所为何事？”
何事？
金灵圣母笑笑，并没有说出自己真实的原因，只是语重心长道：“闻仲，为师之前说过，你的命格是‘逢绝必死’，这次忽然心有所感，以为你的死劫到来，所以过来看看！”
“多谢师尊挂念！”
闻仲听后顿时热泪盈眶，刚要叩谢师尊大恩，就听到金灵圣母继续说道：“不过我知道你意在辅佐人皇，为师也能看出人皇对你的倚重，这样为师就放心了！”
“师尊难得下山一次，不如多逗留几日，再有几天就是八百诸侯觐见大王的日子了，等事情过后，徒儿就向大王告假几日，好好陪陪师尊！”
闻仲说着，直接跪在地上恳求道，
金灵圣母想想左右无事，就当出来散散心，顺便指点下徒儿修炼吧。
想到这，

金灵圣母也没有坚持，点头答应了下来！
……
“启奏大王，现已有三十余名诸侯进入朝歌，皆已安排到了驿站！”
“大王，还有七天就是八百诸侯觐见大王的日子，属下已经加强朝歌内的守卫力量，人皇宫内守卫更是增加一倍，还请大王放心！”
“大王，前有袁福通等七十二路诸侯造反，现在八百诸侯觐见，难保其中没有人心怀叛逆之心，这几日老臣会贴身保护大王！”
第二天早朝，商容、黄飞虎和闻仲先后开口，剑指八百诸侯，整个朝野上下，都被一股紧张的气氛笼罩。
因为他们早已经知道，很多诸侯已经有造反之心，只是他们苦于没有证据！
但对于帝辛的安危，他们却不得不放在心上！
而这时，
帝辛却无所谓地摆了摆手，漫不经心道：“诸位不用担心孤的安危，八百诸侯而已，孤王还没有把他们放在心里！”
“对了，闻太师也不用担心孤的安危，有武成王和袁福通他们在，孤安全得很！”
闻仲听到帝辛那不容置否的话，只好抱拳应道：“老臣遵命！”
这时，
比干忽然走出人群：“大王，八百诸侯觐见之事可大可小，不知这次大王要派谁，前期招待八百诸侯！”
“就派……”
帝辛的话刚刚说到一半，系统的声音忽然在脑海中响起——
“叮：检测到宿主陷入抉择，宿主选择如下……”
content_en:
Chapter 21 Your Majesty, your plans are very big! Chaoge,
Grand Master's Mansion!
"This generation of Human Emperors is a bit extraordinary. They actually want to be the real Lord of the Great Desolate World!"
Our Lady of Jinling looked at Wen Zhong below and said to herself.
Not long ago, she had been in shock after hearing Di Xin say, "If you want this great wasteland, it will all belong to me, the Great Shang."
Even the shock that these words brought to her was several times stronger than when she saw Taoist Bodhi before!
After hearing the words of Our Lady of Jinling, Wen Zhong smiled and nodded——
He said with great pride: "Your Majesty is a man of great talent and strategy. My disciple was entrusted by the late emperor to teach me. I am very pleased!"
This was the first time he saw his master, and he showed several shocked expressions in just one day.
"Well, it seems that I was prejudiced against him before!"
When Madonna Jin Ling thought about her purpose of coming to Chaoge, she felt very funny. If her identity hadn't been here, she would have supported him for several years just based on Di Xin's words.
At this moment, Wen Zhong smiled again and said, "By the way, I wonder why Master is here this time?"
What's the matter?
The Holy Mother Jin Ling smiled and did not tell her true reason. She just said seriously: "Wen Zhong, my teacher said before that your destiny is to 'die in every situation'. This time, I suddenly felt something in my heart and thought that your death was coming, so I came here to take a look!"
"Thank you Master for your concern!"
After hearing this, Wen Zhong burst into tears. Just as he was about to thank his master for his great kindness, he heard the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit continue: "But I know that you intend to assist the Emperor. As a teacher, I can also see that the Emperor relies on you, so I can rest assured!"
"Master rarely comes down the mountain once, so why not stay a few more days? In a few days, it will be the day when the eight hundred princes will meet the king. After everything is over, the disciple will ask the king for a few days' leave to spend time with the master!"
As Wen Zhong spoke, he knelt on the ground and begged,
Holy Mother Jin Ling thought that she had nothing to do, so she just came out to relax and give guidance to her disciples in their cultivation.
Thinking of this,
Our Lady of Golden Spirit did not insist and nodded in agreement!
…
"Your Majesty, more than thirty princes have entered the court, and they have all been arranged to the inn!"
"Your Majesty, there are still seven days until the day when the eight hundred princes will meet your Majesty. My subordinates have already strengthened the guard force in Chaoge, and the guards in the Imperial Palace have doubled. Please rest assured, Your Majesty!"
"Your Majesty, there were seventy-two princes including Yuan Futong who rebelled. Now the eight hundred princes have come to see you. There is no guarantee that none of them will harbor rebellious intentions. I will personally protect your Majesty these days!"
In the morning of the next day, Shang Rong, Huang Feihu and Wen Zhong spoke one after another, pointing their swords at the eight hundred princes. The entire court and the public were enveloped in a tense atmosphere.
Because they already knew that many princes had the intention to rebel, but they suffered from the lack of evidence!
But they had to worry about Di Xin's safety!
And at this time,
Di Xin waved his hands indifferently and said casually: "You don't have to worry about Gu's safety, there are only eight hundred princes, and King Gu has not taken them into his heart yet!"
"By the way, Master Wen doesn't have to worry about Gu's safety. With King Wucheng and Yuan Futong here, Gu is very safe!"
When Wen Zhong heard Di Xin's undeniable words, he had no choice but to clasp his fists and say, "Old minister, I obey!"
At this time,
Bigan suddenly walked out of the crowd: "Your Majesty, the meeting of the eight hundred princes can be big or small. I don't know who the king will send this time to entertain the eight hundred princes in the early stage!"
"Just send..."
Di Xin was just halfway through what he said when the voice of the system suddenly sounded in his mind——
"Ding: It is detected that the host is in a dilemma. The host's choice is as follows..."
